process_items.label: Mint the ebook NFT
process_items.copy: Buy the ebook NFT for $15. The mint number received becomes the buyer's referral code.

process_items.label: Earn Through Referrals
process_items.copy: Share the mint number or referral link. Each completed referral earns an immediate, unlimited $5 commission and one ticket for the recurring $500 drawing.

process_items.label: Build Up Tickets
process_items.copy: Every completed referral automatically adds one on-chain ticket for the active $500 drawing to the holder's NFT and dashboard. More referrals mean more chances to win.

process_items.label: Enter the Prize Draw
process_items.copy: One affiliate from each 100-sales block wins $500 through provably fair Chainlink VRF selection.

process_items.label: Receive Your Rewards
process_items.copy: Commissions are delivered automatically, while a $500 winner is notified on the Winners page, dashboard, and by email when available and collects the prize through a conditional claim button shown only when the prize is eligible to be claimed.

decisions.reason: The claim-flow decision does not change the Small Block prize amount, winner count, draw trigger, eligible ticket window, reset rule, or funding mechanics.
Winner-initiated prize collection occurs after selection and does not change the eligible population, ticket weighting, Chainlink VRF provider, or on-chain selection method.
The prize claim interaction does not change ticket issuance accounting, counters, associations, leaderboard consistency, or historical backfill policy.
The source decision concerns collection of a won $500 prize; the separate $5 referral commission remains an immediate automatic wallet payment.
The View Book action on an owned NFT detail page is unrelated to prize eligibility and the conditional prize-claim button.
Changing how a winner collects a prize does not alter when referral tickets are issued, their recipient, quantity, cycle, or treatment of secondary sales.
The public pool values and next-draw sales counter remain valid regardless of whether the eventual winner claims the prize manually.
The winner-initiated prize claim flow does not change no-referral ticket allocation, random recipient selection, the first-mint exception, or allocation finalization.
The mint-success messages describe distribution of referral commissions and prize-draw tickets, not delivery of a subsequently won $500 prize.
